Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Memnite, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1778-3652-5861-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

Repeat.

6798-6972-7509.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
6798-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

141-5231-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-5231-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {4}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1376-4687-6287.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven Elves on the battlefield.
1376-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Priest of Titania.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G} and untapping it.
Repeat.

698-2726-7043.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Aang either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. When it enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Cast the Aang spell from exile by paying {0}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. Put either Aang token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aang token from step 5 enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.

1409-2933-4927-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

224-277-1772-5621.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Arid Archway
Holding priority, activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

575-1794-2482.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-2482.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Ruthless Ripper.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability.
Activate Ruthless Ripper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
When Ruthless Ripper is turned face up, it triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

2225-3767-3918-5116.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
2225-3767-3918-5116.description:
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

974-1558-5737-5738.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
City of Death has between one and four lore counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Sigurd.
974-1558-5737-5738.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again and City of Death trigger.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability and Sigurd trigger.
Resolve the Sigurd trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Resolve the City of Death trigger, putting a lore counter on it.
City of Death's second chapter ability and Sigurd trigger.
Resolve the Sigurd trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the City of Death trigger, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Declare Sigurd as an attacker.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Sigurd by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from City of Death.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, City of Death triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Repeat from step 7.

803-3168-4518-5613.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3055-3175-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1273-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Soldier.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
The Soldier dies, triggering Seige Veteran and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Siege Veteran trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the nontoken Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Task Force.

Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability, attaching it to Task Force.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Crookclaw Transmuter by paying {3}{U}.
Crookclaw Transmuter enters the battlefield, switching Task Force's power and toughness until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Task Force, causing the opponent to lose the game due to having zero or less life.

2034-2577-3260-4740.notablePrerequisites:
Your storm count is at least one.
Your life total is at least three.
You control at least one additional Zombie.
2034-2577-3260-4740.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and K'rrik triggers.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may use it to activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

3272-4222-4474-4832.notablePrerequisites: Immovable Rod does not have summoning sickness.
3272-4222-4474-4832.description:
Cast Ensoul Artifact enchanting Immovable Rod.
Cast Freed from the Real enchanting Immovable Rod.
Activate Paradise Mantle by paying {1} to equip it to Immovable Rod.
Activate Immovable Rod by tapping it to add {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U} to untap Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time you trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

972-1486-1651.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating an artifact creature copy of Magda.
Put the original Magda in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Clock of Omens and Magda, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping a Treasure token and Magda, targeting Magda.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
Activate Magda's last ability any number of times by sacrificing any number of Treasures.
